_comment: Minimal fixture for the SAMD51 boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit (OSCCTRL / GCLK / OSC32KCTRL synthesis stubs satisfy the busy-wait loops in samd51_clock.c) and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the SERCOM0 pty Renode exposes.
